item.title: HTTP QUERY Method: The Grey Zone Between GET And POST., (Fri, Sep 18th)
item.description: In June 2026 the IETF published RFC 10008[1], defining a new HTTP method: "QUERY". The HTTP protocol faced already by changes (HTTP/2, HTTP/3) but it&#x27s the first new standard HTTP verb since "PATCH" in 2010!
